job.title: 585855 E-Commerce Data, Automation & AI Manager (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: E-Commerce Data, Automation & AI Manager – 585855
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

To win in AI-driven shopping you need clean product data, automation and real AI adoption – I bring 5+ years building digital commerce platforms and data pipelines for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation
– Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, supported UAT

I also configured Apache Solr search indexing for product discovery. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Data, Automation & AI | Generative AI, Data Pipelines & Commerce
tailoring.summary: E-commerce technologist with 5+ years on large digital commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Uses AI tools, generative AI / LLMs and prompt engineering extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation. Automates data flows through pipelines, scheduled jobs and scripting (Java, Groovy), works confidently with SQL, product catalog, pricing and availability data, and has configured Apache Solr search indexing. Translates business requirements into solutions, documents processes and works with cross-functional, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Philips is redefining how its Personal Health products are discovered and recommended by AI shopping assistants – a forward-looking challenge in e-commerce. Combined with Philips' purpose of better healthcare for everyone, it motivates me. I bring five years of digital commerce engineering, product data pipelines and daily generative AI use.

en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Data, Automation & AI Manager – 585855
en.hook: Philips wants to win in AI-driven shopping environments, which starts with clean product data, automated workflows and teams that use AI tools well. That is the intersection I work in: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have built digital commerce platforms and their data pipelines, and I use generative AI every day.

bullets.label: Using AI tools
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation – with prompt engineering and critical review of the output through code reviews.

bullets.label: Automation & scripting
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-commerce data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, scheduled Cronjobs and authored Groovy scripts to keep catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Data, search & digital shelf
bullets.text: Configured Apache Solr search indexing, worked daily with SQL on product, pricing and availability data and led query refactoring that reduced response latency.

bullets.label: Cross-functional teams & change
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, documented processes and functional specifications and worked across international technical and business teams.

en.logistics: I bring the technical depth to make AI and automation ideas real in e-commerce. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about your AI roadmap in Hamburg.
